early.title: Early transmission: The Quiet Part
early.text: Off the record: the first thing that goes quiet near the edge is the radio. Not because anyone stopped talking. Because the words take longer and longer to reach you. I keep logging anyway. Somebody on the other side is reading it, eventually.

early.title: Early transmission: Manifest (draft)
early.text: Crew manifest, draft 1. Name: the astronaut. Cargo: one oxygen tank, one lollipop, one very questionable sense of direction. Destination: the line. Return trip: not scheduled.

classified.title: CLASSIFIED 001: What the instruments say
classified.text: Every gauge on the console agrees on exactly one thing: nothing agrees. Pressure reads poetry. Altitude reads 'yes'. The compass has stopped pointing north and started pointing at me. I have decided this is fine.

classified.title: CLASSIFIED 002: The one who wasn't stretched
classified.text: Tidal forces stretch everything that can't hold together. I checked the crew roster for anyone holding together this well. The list is short, and it is you. (Lore only. Not a promise of anything.)
